conceptBlocks.text: 净销售是扣除折扣、退款后的有效销售额；毛利为净销售减退货冲减后成本，不是扣除租金等费用的净利润。金额使用整数分。目标和订单明细不是同一粒度，须先预聚合。

syntax.purpose: 统计截止日 2025-12-31；金额 整数马币分；比率按题设；输出粒度 门店。

problem: 区域经理核对2025年有效线下订单，退款截至年底并归属原订单日期；每门店一行，无销售门店保留。净额和目标为零时分别不计算对应比率。

methodBlocks.text: 原查询的 sales lines 视图已处理有效订单及退款，因此不能再次减退款。a 汇总净额与成本，b 汇总同期目标，两个结果均为一店一行。主档左连接保证无销售门店仍存在。
分母分别为净额和目标；先计算再舍入。示例第一店净额10000、成本6000，目标12500。若要诊断类别贡献，在销售层按门店和类别分组，不能将门店目标复制到各类别。

breakdown.title: 按门店汇总净销售与成本
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 按门店汇总净销售与成本（a）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

breakdown.title: 按门店合并月度目标
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 按门店合并月度目标（b）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

completeCode.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0) gross_cents,ROUND(100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) margin_pct,b.target target_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0),2) achievement_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC
completeCode.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0) gross_cents,ROUND(100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) margin_pct,b.target target_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0),2) achievement_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY net_cents DESC

resultBlocks.text: 小型示例门店1毛利4000、毛利率40%、目标达成80%；门店2达成100%、毛利率30%；门店3无销售且目标为零，两种比率均未定义。
原企业预览门店1达成9.7%、毛利率39.88%；仅提示偏差，不能单凭此判断管理失误。

extensions.label: 小型示例：独立汇总销售

explanationBlocks.text: 内联的四笔明细含一笔线上订单，排除后按门店聚合。

extensions.sql:
WITH stores AS (SELECT 1 store_id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3),
v_sales_lines AS (SELECT 1 store_id, '2025-01-03' order_date, 'store' channel, 1 category_id, 8000 net_cents, 5000 cost_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-03','store',2,2000,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-05','online',1,9000,4000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01-04','store',1,5000,3500),
sales_targets AS (SELECT 1 store_id,'2025-01' month_key,5000 target_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02',7500 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-01',0),
a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id),
b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY net;

extensions.label: 小型示例：完整门店查询

explanationBlocks.text: 左连接两份汇总并计算指标。

extensions.sql:
WITH stores AS (SELECT 1 store_id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3),
v_sales_lines AS (SELECT 1 store_id, '2025-01-03' order_date, 'store' channel, 1 category_id, 8000 net_cents, 5000 cost_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-03','store',2,2000,1000 UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02-05','online',1,9000,4000 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01-04','store',1,5000,3500),
sales_targets AS (SELECT 1 store_id,'2025-01' month_key,5000 target_cents UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-02',7500 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'2025-01',5000 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-01',0),
a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id),
b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0) gross_cents,ROUND(100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) margin_pct,b.target target_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0),2) achievement_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY net_cents;
